trial_metrics:
Hosted trial (4 weeks) observed:
- Avg sustained QPS (user-facing): 8 req/s during business hours; peak observed 35 QPS (short 30-minute burst).
- Measured concurrency: median 6, 95th pct concurrency ~22 across multi-tenant sandbox.
- Avg tokens per request (input+output): ~420 tokens. Token distribution: 55% <=256 tokens (short support queries), 35% 256-1024 (context + history), 10% >1024 (long docs + thread summarization).
- Latency: short prompts median 140-200ms, medium 350-480ms, long >1024 tokens ~1.1-1.5s. Tail concerns at high concurrency (95th latency spikes).
- Monthly pilot token consumption ~25M tokens (extrapolated from trial weeks).
- Initial cost sensitivity: target reduce per-token spend by ~25-35% vs Hosted using Dedicated + quantization/batching.
dedicated_sizing_and_forecast:
MosaicFlow requested capacity plan and forecast for expected production ramp. Redwood sizing proposal drafts: 
- Production forecast (12 months): target 10k DAUs driving ~45 sustained QPS during business hours, peak bursts up to 150 QPS for flash events. Estimated concurrency target 60 (with autoscaling headroom).
- Token forecast: 600M tokens/month at steady-state (mix as above).
- Suggested Dedicated config (initial): 2 x A100-equivalent pools with autoscale to 4 GPUs for sustained throughput and burst to 8 GPUs for 30-45m windows. Batching profile: continuous batching target 50-100ms aggregation window for short prompts. KV cache hit strategy for session history to reduce tokens by ~18%.
- Expected cost delta: model quantization + responsivity tuning projected to cut per-token inference cost ~30% relative to current Hosted baseline.
- POC ask: 2-week Dedicated trial with telemetry (token-level cost, per-route latency, tail percentiles) + Redwood Optimize recommendations applied.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th pct latency < 600ms on support queries at 80 QPS sustained, monthly token cost within procurement ceiling ($X TBD in pricing deck).
